summary: The gyomu-facts package provides core analysis and directory ranking capabilities for software projects. It compiles package facts, calculates structural scores, and offers flexible directory selection options to evaluate codebase importance.
responsibilities: Provide core analysis capabilities to extract and compile package facts.
Implement scoring and ranking algorithms to order project directories by importance.
Offer configurable selection options for targeting specific package areas.

capabilities.name: Package Analysis
capabilities.description: Compile comprehensive factual summaries and data models representing package structures.

capabilities.name: Directory Ranking
capabilities.description: Evaluate and score directories based on structural importance and configurable criteria.

capabilities.name: Directory Selection
capabilities.description: Configure flexible strategies for filtering and selecting relevant target directories.

design_decisions: Delegates core language-specific parsing and structural analysis to underlying analysis layers.
Employs functional error handling and result containers via external dependency integration.
Separates scoring logic from selection option configurations to maintain modularity.
usage_guidance: Utilize the package analysis module to extract and compile factual data about target codebases.
Apply directory ranking functions with custom scoring criteria to prioritize structural components.
Combine directory selection options to tailor the scope of package evaluations.
